headline: South Africa Seeks New Export Markets as AGOA Exclusion Looms
summary: President Cyril Ramaphosa stated that South Africa is seeking alternative export markets and supporting affected businesses as the country faces exclusion from the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA).
why: Preferential trade agreements like AGOA provide tariff-free access to the US market for key developing economy exports.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Loss of preferential trade access under AGOA threatens export volumes and local employment.
